Overview.Name: Harika Mandava
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) pan fried & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: 2 boiled eggs & small bowl vegetable upma
Option 3: Puffed rice (2 cups) with onion & lemon & 1 boiled egg
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (1 bowl) & vegetable curry
Option 2: 2 chapati & paneer curry (80 g paneer) & salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable fry
Meal_3: Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & cucumber salad
Option 2: Paneer stir fry (80 g paneer) & clear vegetable soup
Option 3: Vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & 1 chapati

Notes_and_Tips: For better physique and fat loss keep eggs or paneer as main portion and limit rice to about 3/4–1 cup cooked.
Since stress triggers overeating, serve food in one fixed plate and pause for 10 minutes before taking more.
Sweet cravings: eat fruit or buttermilk first before choosing any sweets.
Fried and spicy cravings: choose pan fried eggs or roasted makhana instead of deep fried snacks.
Keep meal timings consistent to help hormone balance and reduce irregular cycle symptoms.
Simple cooking like boiling or pan frying will make the plan easy to follow daily.
